tasks.title: Checkpoint overhaul: HEAD + untracked + ignored file protection
actions: Rewrite preAutonomyRun to: record HEAD hash, current branch, git status --porcelain -z --untracked-files=all, git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard -z, and git diff + git diff --cached patches. Save all to a temp directory (mode 0700). Copy untracked files to temp dir preserving relative paths. Return { checkpointDir, head, branch, manifest: { modified, staged, untracked, ignored }, wasDirty, createdAt }.

Rewrite rollbackToCheckpoint to: git reset --hard <head>, git clean -fd (not -fdx to preserve ignored), then restore untracked files from temp dir copy. Verify git status matches manifest. Return { restored: true } or { restored: false, reason } on mismatch.

Rewrite tests: clean tree with untracked file → run modifies both → rollback restores both. Dirty tree with staged+unstaged+untracked → rollback restores all. Concurrent stash (simulate) doesn't break rollback. Clean tree no-untracked → rollback is a no-op that succeeds.
tasks.acceptanceEvidence: All checkpoint scenarios pass: clean, dirty, untracked, ignored, rollback verification.

tasks.title: Review timeouts, durable store wiring, telemetry digest, resource caps
ownedScope: csm-orchestrate/lib/index.mjs (all changes: timeouts, store wiring, digest, caps, backoff)
actions: Add reviewTimeoutMs option (default 300_000). Create raceDeadline(promise, ms, code) helper. Wrap all 5 await sites for adversarialReview/invokeReview/remediationFactory/finalReview. On timeout: synthesize non-ACCEPTED review or null remediation; convert to INCOMPLETE/BLOCKED receipt.

Thread cursorStore into createHostInvocationAdapter. In adapter.invoke: replace process-local consumedApprovals Set with cursorStore.consumeApproval (catch ApprovalAlreadyConsumedError → blocked). Replace terminalInvocations Map check with cursorStore.recordIdempotency (catch DuplicateIdempotencyError → rejected).

In index.mjs before each adapter.invoke: call cursorStore.claimCursor (catch CasMismatchError → BLOCKED stale-writer) and cursorStore.createDispatchIntent. After result: cursorStore.resolveDispatchIntent.

Fix telemetry digest: if telemetryEmitter provided but effectiveConfigDigest null, either auto-compute from resolveSkillConfig or throw TypeError. Add emit calls for 'approval' event on each auto-approval mint.

Add maxOutputSize option (default 2MB): after each result from adapter.invoke, check JSON.stringify(result).length; on breach replace with policy failure. Add retryBackoffMs option (default 1000): before retry invoke, await exponential backoff delay.
